sources.fact: A hostname substring does not establish URL identity. Here the observable defect is formatting skipped for ordinary prose or an unrelated URL.
Custom escaping can mishandle existing escape characters. Use a tested argument encoder instead.
The installed 2.4.0 library preserves interpolated values as single arguments; pre-escaping changes literal data. A real temporary Git fixture verifies this contract.

Equivalent formatter skip defect was reported and closed on 2026-10-07. Both pinned and current template use a structured badge recognizer; current version writer uses argv-based runStrict. No duplicate upstream report is needed.
